title: THE GROUND GETS WET
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it (item 12, richer ground). Rain and storms changed what you could hear and see, but the ground looked exactly as dry as on a clear night. The ground now soaks up the rain over about 20 seconds and dries over about a minute and a half after it stops, and while it is wet it is a touch darker and every lamp throws more of its colour across it, the wet shine of a street after rain. Nothing about play changes.
now: Rain now soaks the ground: it darkens and the lamps shine on it, and it dries slowly after.
